How import works

Only identified songs are added, once each, in file order. Existing playlists and audio files stay unchanged. Matching uses the full library, including songs hidden by filters. An uncertain entry is skipped.

The file keeps playlist order and includes songs hidden by filters. Missing references and unusable paths are omitted from this file; they remain in the Songlass playlist. Audio files are not copied.

Check the destination, permissions and free space, then try again. A document created by the provider may be empty or incomplete; the Songlass playlist is unchanged.
